title: Junta invariance under real encoding
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. Then the real-valued sign representation of $f$ depends on at most $r$ coordinates if and only if $f$ does.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
